is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses exclusively on Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data for any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers; it only discusses previously published resistance data in the introduction and discussion.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are reported for the mosquitoes used in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses Aedes aegypti populations from Brazil, which is not in Africa.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating locomotor activity.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies municipalities in São Paulo state, Brazil (Campinas, Marília, Santos, Ribeirão Preto).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports data for 2016 and 2017.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new experimental data on locomotor activity.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data for the study's conclusions are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the locomotor activity of four field populations of Aedes aegypti from São Paulo, Brazil, compared to the Rockefeller strain. It does not genotype insecticide-resistance markers, nor does it study Anopheles mosquitoes.
